cns_dep.t: CNS Depressants and Alcohol Baclofen oral solution can cause CNS depression, including drowsiness and sedation, which may be additive when used concomitantly with other CNS depressants or alcohol [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.3 )] .
Advise patients that the central nervous system effects of baclofen oral solution may be additive to those of alcohol and other CNS depressants.
